---
title: "Unified Report Model"
---

SCGSim provides strict solver-specific resolvers and a consistent notebook
reading surface without pretending different physical quantities are
identical.

## Common envelope

Current Palace reports organize:

1. physical quantities;
2. convergence and solver diagnostics;
3. simulation cost and resource benchmarks;
4. provenance and artifact identities.

## Honesty rule

Solver-specific quantities remain solver-specific. Electrostatic matrices,
eigenfrequencies, driven network responses, field-energy participation, Q3D
matrices, and Q2D per-unit-length results must retain their own units,
extraction authority, and failure meaning.

Palace returns native tabular summaries by default and can render Plotly tables
when Plotly is explicitly installed and requested. AEDT resolved runs expose
receipt-bound native physics rows and execution benchmarks. Presentation never
weakens receipt, artifact-hash, or solver-identity validation.
